responses.challenge: Existing renderer coverage narrows the missing-renderer claim.
responses.response: Accepted. I have now read refinement/evidence/geometry-checks.json: 504 matched samples report zero day/night geometry mismatches, before/after anatomy mismatches and invalid SVG. My initial finding applied to motion.test.mjs, not the whole evidence inventory. Reuse the existing renderer coverage. Paint is excluded, and two added antenna-edge paths are excluded specifically from before/after comparison; these exclusions do not establish perceived contour equality or occlusion quality. I inspected the report, not its generation run.

responses.challenge: Existing interrupted-hop evidence is stronger than B initially inspected.
responses.response: Accepted. I have now viewed exact-case-9.png. Its selected excited→angry→worried frames retain compact anatomy and connected parts. This reduces the uncertainty to perceived uninterrupted timing and intended cases not represented. Excited→sad is an optional distinct probe, not a mandatory substitute or demand to certify every transition.

responses.challenge: Thinking/grateful density may be intended contact.
responses.response: Accepted. Chin support and gratitude gathering are legitimate contacts; lower-hand separation already improved. Treat my density concern as a size-dependent readability hypothesis. Do not separate every contour or enlarge anatomy to satisfy it.

explicitCorrection: I endorse the pair's bounded evidence inventory, application-size review and invariant checks. I do not endorse a literal defect-only permission gate in A's criteria or pair P3. Reversible staging/timing exploration may pursue appeal without a proven defect; adopting a variant requires a named observed benefit and no unacceptable regression. The whole-team proposal states this distinction correctly.
limits: Normal-speed playback has not been observed by me in this review.
This endorsement approves a plan; it awards no score and does not approve future artwork.
